svg.text: Side effects — three crash windows, two guards
dedup covers 1 of 3 · the idempotency key covers 3 of 3
2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the value being summed (also, here, the amount to charge)
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[4] = (id 4, key "a", et 245, pt 246, v 6) <- the order this chapter charges
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: WIN — the window width, in seconds of event time. WIN = 120
10 // primitive: CHK — the index whose state was checkpointed before the crash. CHK = 4
11 // primitive: TOTAL — the dataset's true total. TOTAL = 45
12 // primitive: winOf(et) — the START of the window holding et.
14 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
15 // primitive: contains(xs, x) — is x in xs? contains([1,2], 2) = true
20 // primitive: ORDER — the record this concept charges. ORDER = EVENTS[4], amount 6
21 // primitive: CRASH_POINTS — where the pipeline can die mid-charge.
22 // CRASH_POINTS = ["before the shuffle", "after the shuffle, before the charge", "after the charge, before the offset commit"]
24 // function: charge(proc, key, amount) — the external call. The PROCESSOR decides,
25 // because it is the only component that can see both attempts.
26 // charge(proc, "order-4", 6) then the same call again leaves totalCharged = 6
28 if (contains(proc.chargedKeys, key)) { return proc } // already done
34 // primitive: nextCounter() — 1, then 2, then 3 ... a fresh value per call.
37 // function: keyFor(e, fromData) — the idempotency key. Derived from the DATA, or
38 // generated at send time — and the second one is useless.
40 // keyFor(ORDER, false) = "send-1", then "send-2" (a NEW key per attempt)
46 // function: attempt(proc, crashAt, useDedup, useKey) — one run that crashes at a
47 // given point, then retries. Returns what was charged.
49 // attempt(proc, "after the charge, before the offset commit", true, false).charged = 12
50 // attempt(proc, "after the charge, before the offset commit", false, true).charged = 6
55 if (crashAt == "before the shuffle") { seen = append(seen, ORDER.id) }
56 if (useKey) { proc = charge(proc, keyFor(ORDER, true), ORDER.v) }
57 if (useKey == false) { proc = charge(proc, keyFor(ORDER, false), ORDER.v) }
63 // function: coverage(useDedup, useKey) — how many crash points this pair covers.
68 val o = attempt(Processor([], 0), p, useDedup, useKey)
74 // function: main() — THE CALLER: the two guards, scored.
78 val worst = attempt(Processor([], 0), "after the charge, before the offset commit", true, false)
p = "after the charge, before the offset commit"
Step 4/0 — so the two guards are NOT interchangeable here

`byDedup` = 1 and `byKey` = 3. In the previous concept these two guards were redundant for an aggregation; here they are not, and the reason is structural: dedup is inside the pipeline, and 2 of the 3 crash points are
after the point where the pipeline stops knowing anything.
